name: adscrawl
description: Read rendered web pages and capture screenshots with AdsCrawl browsers.

interface.longDescription: AdsCrawl lets Codex fetch browser-rendered Markdown, HTML and article data, capture PNG screenshots, and use remote browser sessions for interactive work.
defaultPrompt: Read this JavaScript-heavy page and summarize it.
Capture a full-page screenshot of this URL.
